page.layout: One printed page. Full-width running text at top (italic, two lines of Latin above a rule). Below the rule two parallel columns of abbreviation entries: left column and right column, read top to bottom. Column 1 ends with the line "Iuv. Iuvenalis, poëta satyricus." Column 2 ends with "Ter. Terentius, poëta comicus." followed by "Tib." at lower right, which is a catchword-like mark in the column. No margin notes. Printed signature mark at the foot right ("ii") is not transcribed.

p.i: rint. Hoc autem ideò: ut facilius attendere queant, moniti, non omnia communi stylo convenire, quæ grandi stylo usus Orator, vel Poëta, aut ludens Comicus, extulit. Ita ergo habendum.

main_text.l: Amm. Legatur Ammianus, qui historicus fuit posterioris ævi.
Aug. Augustinus : Ecclesiasticus scriptor, inter Patres primarius.
Cic. Cicero, Orator, Latinæ eloquentiæ parens.
Cæl. Cælius Rhodiginus, scriptor è neotericis tersus.
Gell. A. Gellius (aliis Agellius) historicus & criticus.

page.notes: Abbreviation entries are set in italic and roman; the scan is faded in places. Doubtful: "Ad. Iun." and "Iul. Capitolinus" (the first word of the latter is partly damaged, read as Iul. Capitolinus from context). The line "Iuv. Iuvenalis" is partly obscured at the left edge. The "Tib." at lower right is a printed mark; the page's signature mark at bottom right is not transcribed.
